articles.title: U.S. seeks $1.1 billion seized in Binance hack as North Korean funds keep moving
articles.snippet: U.S. seeks to recover $1.1 billion in frozen USDC as billions more from the Binance hack remain unaccounted for.

articles.title: Justice Department Moves to Forfeit $1.1B in USDC From North Korea's Binance Hack
articles.snippet: U.S. authorities say they've now helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion of the crypto stolen from Binance in October.
